approved_text: OSA may disturb a partner through snoring, pauses, gasping, worry, and lost sleep. Effective PAP may reduce obstructive breathing and shared-sleep disruption, but it cannot guarantee relationship improvement. Support should be blame-free.
source_title: Existing Sleep Education curriculum: shared sleep

approved_text: OSA treatment reduces obstructive breathing, but PAP barriers are common. Useful categories include congestion, dryness, discomfort, leak, tubing, airflow, anxiety, reflux, partner concerns, uncertain benefit, and unclear concerns. Do not change pressure or medication without the appropriate team.
source_title: Existing Sleep Education curriculum: PAP barriers

approved_text: El tratamiento reduce la respiración obstructiva, pero las barreras de PAP son comunes. Incluyen congestión, sequedad, molestias, fuga, tubos, flujo, ansiedad, reflujo y preocupaciones de pareja. No cambie presión ni medicamentos sin el equipo apropiado.
source_title: Existing Sleep Education curriculum: barreras de PAP

approved_text: Approved categories: nasal congestion, dryness, mask discomfort, mask leak, tubing or equipment, airflow discomfort, anxiety or claustrophobia, reflux, partner or bedroom concern, uncertain benefit, and other or unclear. Ask at most one clarification question. Never diagnose, select medication, recommend pressure, determine pregnancy safety, or guarantee outcomes.
source_title: Existing Sleep Education curriculum: approved PAP categories

approved_text: Categorías aprobadas: congestión nasal, sequedad, molestia o fuga de mascarilla, tubos o equipo, flujo, ansiedad o claustrofobia, reflujo, pareja o dormitorio, beneficio incierto y otro o poco claro. Nunca diagnostique, elija medicamentos, recomiende presión, determine seguridad del embarazo ni garantice resultados.
source_title: Existing Sleep Education curriculum: categorías de PAP

approved_text: Plans may use only non-medical actions: specify a realistic habit, timing, expected barrier, backup plan, observation to record, or question for a care team. Never promise sleep improvement, recommend medication, or change PAP settings.
source_title: Existing Sleep Education curriculum: non-medical action plans

approved_text: Los planes solo usan acciones no médicas: hábito realista, momento, barrera, plan alternativo, observación o pregunta para el equipo. Nunca prometen mejorar el sueño, recomiendan medicamentos ni cambian PAP.
source_title: Existing Sleep Education curriculum: planes no médicos
